key_insight: The paper formalizes an end-to-end, composable security proof for entanglement-based BB84 in Lean, removing hidden assumptions and enabling machine-checked quantum cryptography proofs.
engineering_relevance: This creates a reproducible standard for verifying quantum security arguments and shows that theorem provers plus LLM autoformalization can accelerate both proof construction and protocol optimization.
method: Formalized the BB84 security theorem in Lean using only standard axioms
Proved composable security against coherent attacks via the postselection technique
Used an LLM-based autoformalization pipeline to translate and refine the proof
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a complete Lean formalization of composable security for entanglement-based qubit BB84 with finite block-size accounting and a subsequent reduction in the finite-size key-rate penalty.
watch_item: The result depends on the fidelity of the Lean formalization and the modeling assumptions chosen for local operations, classical communication, and the postselection-based security framework.
paper_title: Quantum Cryptography and Autoformalization in Lean
